## Problem

What problem would this feature solve?

## Proposed behavior

Describe what you want FloraCore/FloraOS to do.

## Who benefits?

Who would use this and why?

## Affected component

- [ ] Firmware
- [ ] FloraOS backend
- [ ] Dashboard/frontend
- [ ] Setup/provisioning
- [ ] Automation
- [ ] OTA
- [ ] Hardware
- [ ] Documentation/tooling

## Security / safety impact

Could this affect device ownership, authentication, physical actuation, OTA, secrets, BLE/Wi-Fi setup, or user data? If yes, explain.

## Testing idea

How could we verify that the feature works correctly?

## Additional context

Mockups, diagrams, examples, or related issues are welcome.
